findings.quote: This lesson follows IUPAC 2013, which chooses the longest chain first.
findings.problem: The year 2013 is a number in prose and is not wrapped in inline math. The guide wraps every number in prose, and other lessons write years as $1808$ and $1859$. It is the only bare number left in the teaching text.
findings.source: Checklist B08; lesson-style-guide, Math notation (every number in prose is wrapped in inline math)

findings.quote: Halogen groups such as $-Cl$ and $-Br$ appear only as a prefix, as in chloromethane.
findings.problem: The Functional Groups paragraph that starts 'Names treat groups in different ways' has four sentences. The guide allows one to three short sentences in a paragraph. Earlier rounds did not flag it.
